title: Vathiyaar
desc: Annadurai, an ordinary school teacher, turns into a Good Samaritan and runs an orphanage after a tragic incident. However, his actions are closely watched by ACP Easwara Pandian and his team.

title: Sakalakala Vallavan
desc: When a poor villager's sister is sexually assaulted by the village head's son, the former vows to exact revenge and promises to get his sister married to the culprit.

title: Sathriyan
desc: When Guna, a local thug, falls in love with the daughter of a late mafia leader, he decides to turn over a new leaf. However, his girlfriend's family is against their relationship.

title: Kaanchaana
desc: Three friends find themselves in a dilemma when a money launderer begins to threaten them. In order to get rid of him, they decide to rob a bank.

title: Mayakkam Enna
desc: Karthik is a wildlife photographer, who meets Yamini, his friend's girlfriend, and gets married to her by a twist of fate. Their married life turns sour when Yamini has a miscarriage.

title: Thulli Ezhunthathu Kadhal
desc: A group of friends try to navigate their lives, careers and relationships while hurdling over various challenges life poses in front of them.

title: Thullum Kaalam
desc: Sindhu, a carefree man, falls in love with Divya, who hails from a wealthy family. Meanwhile, Thamizhselvi, his haughty cousin, searches for a rich groom, but fate deals them a humiliating hand.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Ambasamuthiram Ambani
desc: Dhandapani dreams of becoming rich like Ambani, the industrialist, and invests in a shop constructed by Annachi. However, trouble ensues when Annachi dies before giving him possession of the property.

title: Sye Raa Narasimha Reddy
desc: Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy, the ruler of the Rayalaseema region, resists the tyranny of the East India Company and sparks a revolution in the process.
